compute_kid: compute the Kernel Inception Distance (KID) score between real and generated image features using the Inception network
run_compute_kid: run compute_kid to evaluate GAN image quality by comparing real and generated feature distributions
test_compute_kid: test compute_kid with a dataset and generator to verify KID score calculation is correct
review_compute_kid: review compute_kid to understand the polynomial kernel MMD computation for GAN evaluation metrics
refactor_compute_kid: refactor compute_kid to support a different kernel function or feature extractor for KID scoring
